failurePoint: Request cannot be proven to have reached handler (network loss, timeout, abort); frontend init failure before push is a separate no-push path.
currentDb: No push mutation effect can be inferred if request never reached push; if transport outcome is unknown, server may still be executing.
currentReceipt: Unknown until queried; no per-key query exists.
currentHttp: Axios timeout is 30s; no-response errors become ApiError network failure.
currentIDB: push throw exits result loop; outbox is not deleted in catch.
currentNextAction: A later sync resends the persisted outbox record with same clientMutationId and current stored fields.
lastDurableCopy: Client outbox row remains; server outcome unknown.
sourceProposedContract: Keep exact original key and payload/hash; retry same immutable command or query key-scoped outcome. Never mint a new key while outcome is unknown.
futureAssertion: 未到达handler不推断写入；outcome unknown时保留原key/hash，按已批准的actor/device范围查询或同key/hash重放。

failurePoint: Before per-item loop: device upsert, visibility read, or receipt prefetch fails.
currentDb: Device upsert at sync.js:348 may already have persisted; no per-item business mutation has started.
currentReceipt: No new per-item receipt has been written by this request.
currentHttp: 500 is surfaced as ApiError; no automatic 5xx replay.
currentIDB: Outbox remains because push rejects before results are iterated.
currentNextAction: Retry the same queued commands; no key-specific status query.
lastDurableCopy: Client outbox; device metadata may also be present server-side.
sourceProposedContract: Return/lookup explicit per-command outcome by immutable key. For failures before any command executes, retain client last copy and safely retry same key/hash.
futureAssertion: 设备元数据可与命令提交不同；未执行的command无业务效果，客户端副本保留并用原key/hash恢复。

failurePoint: Item is malformed (missing key/entity/id), or entity validation/access/permission rejects before mutation.
currentDb: No business mutation for malformed or denied item. Access/validation outcomes inside try become rejected.
currentReceipt: Malformed item at sync.js:379-382 continues without persisting SyncMutation; ordinary rejected item is upserted as a receipt at 546-567.
currentHttp: If complete 200 response arrives, per-item rejected is treated as definitive by client.
currentIDB: Rejected response moves a keyed row to deadLetters and removes it in one IDB transaction; if response is lost, original outbox remains.
currentNextAction: Missing-field item can be repeatedly rejected without a receipt; ordinary rejection retry is re-evaluated and can overwrite the same global key record.
lastDurableCopy: On delivered reject: deadLetter plus atomic outbox removal. On response loss: outbox.
sourceProposedContract: Every accepted command key must have durable terminal/pending outcome, including malformed keyed commands where safe; bind actor/device/key/hash; reject changed payload/actor.
futureAssertion: 缺key坏项与已键控拒绝分开；不得泄露其它actor回执。

failurePoint: Business operation errors before commit / transactional subcommand rolls back.
currentDb: Expected operation-specific rollback where the command itself uses a transaction (e.g. task compound changes at sync.js:479-491); not all entity operations share a single outer transaction.
currentReceipt: Caught error is converted to rejected/conflict; then a separate SyncMutation upsert is attempted. If it succeeds, response contains per-item result.
currentHttp: A full result response is processed; outer receipt failure or later failure produces 500 instead.
currentIDB: Rejected is moved atomically to deadLetters; conflict is removed from outbox and accumulated for local conflict state.
currentNextAction: Same-key replay of applied only; rejected/conflict entries are reprocessed and their global receipt overwritten.
lastDurableCopy: For delivered rejection: deadLetters. For conflict: server SyncMutation may persist, but local deletion precedes final conflict kvSet (see FP-09).
sourceProposedContract: Atomically persist command decision and outcome; stable key/hash semantics make retries deterministic. Last local copy must be committed before removing outbox.
futureAssertion: 按每命令事务保证业务、必要审计、回执一致；批次前序提交独立保留。

failurePoint: Business mutation commits, then SyncMutation upsert fails (B06).
currentDb: Business write can be committed; historical task probe observed committed title despite HTTP 500. Other entity/op effects vary: stale-base updates may later conflict; no-base updates may reapply; create may collide; tombstone/delete may repeat. No generic at-most-once claim.
currentReceipt: Absent or previous record remains because separate upsert failed.
currentHttp: Outer error becomes HTTP 500; client receives no per-item results.
currentIDB: Original mutation row remains; retry uses same clientMutationId, entity/op/id/data/baseUpdatedAt from outbox.
currentNextAction: If receipt absent, current server processes again; generic query route is absent. Results are operation-specific and may diverge from original attempt.
lastDurableCopy: Client outbox plus mutated server business row; this is the proven ambiguity.
sourceProposedContract: One DB commit boundary for authorization/CAS/business/audit/scoped receipt; unknown result resolved by exact-key/exact-hash status lookup or exact immutable same-key retry.
futureAssertion: 业务及回执须在单命令同提交边界；提交前回执失败不能留下B06孤儿。

failurePoint: Earlier item receipt persisted; a later item receipt write fails before batch completes.
currentDb: Earlier business mutations and receipts persist independently; failing item may also have its business mutation committed; later items are not processed. Batch is sequential and has no encompassing transaction.
currentReceipt: Earlier receipts persist; failing item receipt may be absent; later item receipts absent.
currentHttp: Outer 500 returns no partial results array.
currentIDB: All original outbox rows remain because response promise rejects before result processing.
currentNextAction: Retry resubmits entire batch: earlier applied receipts are replayed; missing receipt items reprocess; later items execute for first time.
lastDurableCopy: Client retains batch records; server may hold partial business/receipt state.
sourceProposedContract: Specify per-command outcome despite batch interruption; per-item atomic receipt and exact replay. Do not promise batch atomicity.
futureAssertion: 前序item业务+receipt已持久；失败item业务可能已提交但receipt缺失；后续项未执行；整个batch不会因500整体回滚。

failurePoint: All item receipts persisted, then lastPushAt update fails before response; aggregate audit insert failures are caught by writeAudit and do not ordinarily cause 500.
currentDb: Business writes and per-item receipts may all be durable; lastPushAt update may fail. writeAudit catches DB insert failures and logs them, so those alone do not fail the request; invalid audit action normalization could throw, but this route supplies the fixed valid UPDATE constant.
currentReceipt: Per-item receipt rows have already been written.
currentHttp: A failure of the uncaught lastPushAt update yields 500/no usable results. Audit insert errors are swallowed and normally still permit 200 response.
currentIDB: Outbox remains if the request fails before the response promise resolves; if response arrives normally, per-item outcomes are processed.
currentNextAction: For lastPushAt failure, retry normally hits applied receipts and replays their stored results. Aggregate audit insertion failure does not require a retry because request continues.
lastDurableCopy: After lastPushAt failure: server receipts plus client outbox. If aggregate audit insert fails but response succeeds, result processing proceeds normally.
sourceProposedContract: Response loss resolves from scoped durable result; required per-command audit is inside the same command commit boundary. Keep aggregate best-effort audit semantics explicitly separate if retained.
futureAssertion: 全部item业务/receipt已经持久后lastPushAt失败导致500；这不是未提交。聚合best-effort audit错误与未捕获lastPushAt失败分开。

failurePoint: Receipt committed and response sent, but response is lost in network or client times out.
currentReceipt: Stored result exists if all item writes completed.
currentHttp: A no-response timeout/network error is thrown; 5xx is surfaced, not automatically retried.
currentNextAction: Next manual/online sync resubmits same key. Applied record replays if still retained; no expiry/retention policy is proven for SyncMutation in this review.
lastDurableCopy: Server receipt and client outbox; after server retention expires, only client outbox may remain.
sourceProposedContract: Scoped outcome lookup or same-key/hash replay within published retention. Beyond retention, unknown/expired remains held for recovery; never silently re-key.
futureAssertion: receipt已提交但响应丢失；客户端outbox保留；查询或原key/hash重放辨认已提交结果，禁止新key盲重试。

failurePoint: A 200 response is received, but client crashes midway through per-result local processing.
currentDb: Per-item receipts remain for processed commands, subject to retention.
currentReceipt: Applied/conflict/rejected records are stored by server before response except malformed items without key/receipt.
currentHttp: Response resolved; engine processes items sequentially.
currentIDB: Applied: server receipt permits replay after outbox deletion. Rejected: deadLetterMove atomically stores copy then deletes outbox. Conflict: outbox is deleted immediately, but merged conflict list is persisted only after the whole loop; a crash between delete and kvSet can leave no local copy (server receipt is not available by-key through current API).
currentNextAction: Recovery differs by per-result status; omitted results are not deleted and stay in outbox because runtime validates neither response completeness nor request/result key-set equality.
lastDurableCopy: For conflict there is a possible client last-copy gap; server DB receipt exists but not client-visible by key.
sourceProposedContract: For every status, atomically retain a local outcome copy before outbox deletion; validate complete key-set and expose server lookup.
futureAssertion: 结果副本必须在删除outbox之前原子持久；重点验证conflict崩溃窗口。

failurePoint: SyncMutation row is later expired/deleted or request retry falls outside actual retention window.
currentDb: Schema has createdAt but no expiry field; external cleanup job/effective retention was not checked and remains S03-OI-04.
currentReceipt: Historical S03 static review found no cleanup in push path; deployment/ops cleanup remains unknown.
currentHttp: No key-specific lookup; `/sync/status` reports aggregate counts only.
currentIDB: Outbox/deadletter row may remain locally, but no expiry protocol or re-key guard is established by this path.
currentNextAction: Cannot infer whether retry replays or reprocesses after cleanup.
lastDurableCopy: Client outbox/deadletter if retained; effective server receipt retention unknown.
sourceProposedContract: Expose explicit retained/expired/unknown per key; preserve original key/hash and last local copy; expired/unknown blocks automatic re-key/replay pending authorized recovery.
futureAssertion: 超出获批retention/offline window时显式unknown/expired并人工恢复；不能静默re-key。
